Name: Fastestboi's Additional Weapons
Author: FastestBoi
Description:
[b]Fastestboi's Additional weapons[/b] mod adds couple melee weapons for extra variety but for now this mod  is too small to accept as a mod.

My main purpose was creating weapons that are [b]not op or expensive.[/b] I wanted to make them all compatabile with classic stardew valley, it just adds little different images.

Don't hesitate to tell your opinions [i][b]I need criticism!!
